Who it affects: Volunteers who paste text into a terminal

Product: cli (a Python command-line program)
</request>

Problem: Run-length encoding puzzle answers
Who it affects: Puzzle site editors
Problem statement: A puzzle site writes answers in run-length encoding. The tool takes exactly one argument and does not read standard input; it treats the argument as a sequence of Unicode code points and compares them exactly (A and a differ).
